hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Consider determining the candidate set bits of the resulting value from most significant to least significant.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For a trial answer target, every row must contain at least one element whose set bits are a subset of target.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Start with target having all bits set and test if each bit can be turned off greedily.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Checks feasibility for each of 30 bit positions across all rows and columns.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all n^m row selections causes an exponential explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterates greedily bit-by-bit using constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses greedy bitwise feasibility checking from high to low order bits.
